Subject: Application for Fifth-Face Position, Mount Rushmore National Memorial  

Dear Hiring Official:  

I am writing to formally apply for the open fifth-face position at Mount Rushmore National Memorial. I appreciate the opportunity to be considered for a role of such national visibility, historical significance, and long-term public-facing responsibility.

I believe my qualifications align strongly with the requirements of the position. I have extensive experience maintaining a composed public presence under scrutiny, with demonstrated capacity for symbolic representation, interpretive endurance, and nonverbal civic engagement. I am prepared to serve in a permanent, highly visible capacity and to uphold the dignity, stability, and interpretive mission of the National Park Service.

If selected, I would approach the position with respect for the Memorial’s historic context, the surrounding Black Hills landscape, and the diverse perspectives of the American public. I understand that this role requires not only facial durability and monumental bearing, but also sound judgment, neutrality, and a commitment to public service across generations.

My relevant competencies include:

- Sustained front-facing availability in all weather conditions;  
- Ability to maintain a fixed expression during periods of national debate;  
- Strong symbolic communication skills;  
- Commitment to preservation, stewardship, and visitor engagement;  
- Demonstrated readiness for granite-level accountability; and  
- Willingness to undergo any required background, geologic, or chiseling review.

I recognize that placement on Mount Rushmore would be an extraordinary public trust. I would be honored to contribute to the National Park Service’s mission of preserving unimpaired the natural and cultural resources and values of the National Park System for the enjoyment, education, and inspiration of this and future generations.

Thank you for your time and consideration. I welcome the opportunity to provide any additional materials required in support of my application and to discuss my suitability for this position at your convenience.

Respectfully submitted,  

[Your Name]
